workProduct.subject: Update on your Willow Support enrollment and next step
workProduct.body:
Hi Taylor,

Thank you — we received your enrollment and Birch Specialty Pharmacy has recorded the prescription intake. One item is still needed before the pharmacy can finish its checks: the consent form is missing a required signature. Please complete the consent through the program’s secure channel when you’re able.

After the pharmacy receives and confirms the signed consent, they will complete their administrative checks. At that point they can determine dispense readiness and provide any shipment confirmation. I can’t promise a delivery date or shipping outcome here.

If you have clinical questions about the medication or dosing, please check with your treating clinician or the pharmacy pharmacist. If you complete the consent and want me to check the record, let me know and I can ask the intake team to confirm receipt.

Thanks,
Jordan Rivera
Willow Support
